The best small business accounting software depends on your unique needs. Ideally, your software should cover the core finance features you use every day - like invoicing, payroll, expenses, and cash flow management. It should also be customizable with apps and integrations specific to your industry, so you can automate accounting tasks to spend less time on admin and make your to-do list more manageable, at a price that works for you.
